preconditions.description: The length of string s is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
The integer k is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.
String s contains only lowercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: return_value == 'YES' if k * (len(s) // k) == len(s) and all(s[i:i+len(s)//k] == s[i:i+len(s)//k][::-1] for i in range(0, len(s), len(s)//k)) else return_value == 'NO'
postconditions.description: The output is 'YES' if s can be split into k palindromes of the same length, otherwise 'NO'.
